Subject: Post-fix validation window & evidence request — ClearHealth pen test

Alex / Marissa,

Thanks again for partnering on the ClearHealth penetration test. ProofStrike completed the engagement and shared the report this morning. There are three medium findings (session management cookies, an instance of over-broad S3 ACL in a staging rollout, and an information exposure in a diagnostic log) that our team has marked as remediated in the attached summary.

We need Redwood to confirm the following so we can close the SOC 2 control evidence loop on our side:
- A short attestation from Redwood that the fixes have been deployed to the production environment and the changes are under your change management controls.
- Any remediation artifacts you can share (patch IDs, deployment runbook, or short delta report).
- Availability for ProofStrike to run the limited re-test (target window: Feb 8-12).

Can your team provide an attestation PDF and the remediation summary by COB Feb 2? If you prefer, we can schedule the re-test earlier but ProofStrike needs confirmation of the build/deploy where the fixes live.

Morgan
Morgan Lee
Security Lead, ClearHealth
Morgan.Lee@clearhealth.com
